context: Replaces nested match arms that flatten every failure into a String with a typed ConfigError.
explanation: load_config previously hand-matched each env::var/parse call and mapped failures into an opaque String. The new ConfigError uses #[from] to convert VarError and ParseIntError automatically, letting `?` do the work while load_config now reads as two clean lines. Callers keep the original error type and can match on the failure kind instead of parsing a message string, and the underlying cause is preserved via thiserror's #[error] formatting.
